content.about: The Netherlands is a low, flat country in Western Europe on the North Sea, with about a quarter of it below sea level. Dikes, windmills and canals keep the water out. It is known for tulips, cheese and bicycles. Amsterdam is built on many canals.

standout.text: The Delta Works are one of the largest flood-protection systems in the world.

didYouKnow: There are more bicycles than people in the Netherlands.
Flevoland was reclaimed from the sea in the 20th century.
The Netherlands is one of the world's largest food exporters.
